name: manual_45ef37
claim: For model execution, keep Phylax as the fail-closed authority for human evidence, receipt single-use, and audit; expose executable and MCPB runtime routes only behind a transport-neutral contract owned by the runtime and orchestration layers, so both routes receive the same verified intent and produce comparable normalized evidence.

decisions.notes: The 2026-10-23 model-launch design separates authorization from provider execution: executable and Claude-Desktop-LLM MCPB are benchmarkable alternatives, not alternate trust roots. Agate owns placement and Telos owns endpoint policy.

rationale: The 2026-10-23 model-launch design separates authorization from provider execution: executable and Claude-Desktop-LLM MCPB are benchmarkable alternatives, not alternate trust roots. Agate owns placement and Telos owns endpoint policy.
